notes: I found no defects; all eight diffs were read in full. OUTCOME: src/hud.js adds a pure hudModel(state). It returns { lives, gold, wave, totalWaves, paused, speed, livesDanger }, with livesDanger true at 3 lives or fewer (lives <= 3). It reads the state through destructuring and never writes to it. test/hud.test.js covers every hudModel criterion: the new-game values, 4 lives versus 3, gold and wave after they change, and a structuredClone check that the state is unchanged.

OUTCOME: src/game.js adds paused:false and speed:1 to createGame, plus togglePause and toggleSpeed (1 to 2 and back). step returns early while paused. Otherwise it runs `speed` ticks of dt and stops as soon as the round leaves 'playing'. test/pause-speed.test.js shows a paused step leaves the whole state deep-equal (enemy positions, spawn timer and tower reload), and that one step(0.5) at 2x matches two step(0.5) calls at 1x.

OUTCOME, item (3), the dt cap: 2x is now two ticks of the frame's dt, never one tick of 2·dt. main.js still clamps dt to 0.05, so no tick is ever longer than 0.05s. A test shows a 0.6s frame at 2x fires two shots, and another shows a round lost on the first tick runs no second tick.

OUTCOME, item (1), the board's top row: the board is drawn under ctx.translate(0, HUD_HEIGHT) and the canvas is HUD_HEIGHT + ROWS*TILE tall, so the bar sits above the board and covers no cell. boardCellAt maps y=HUD_HEIGHT to row 0 and any point on the bar to null. Tests check where the drawing lands: every HUD shape stays within the bar's 0 to HUD_HEIGHT band, and row 0's grass starts at HUD_HEIGHT.

OUTCOME, item (2), the main.js wiring: main.js is booted against DOM stand-ins. Tests show a click on the bar places no tower while a click on row 0 does, clicks on Pause and 1x toggle them, hover clears over the bar, and P/F toggle while the round is playing, with auto-repeat ignored. Item (4): test/hud.test.js is a new file, and its comment that the board is drawn below the bar is now accurate.

OUTCOME, theme rule: all HUD colours are new THEME tokens in src/theme.js and render.js adds no colour literal. test/render.test.js's 'Lives: 10' assertion was updated to the HUD's texts, and its end-card slices were updated because the HUD now draws after the end card.

CONSTRUCTION: no defect found. restart goes through createGame, which resets paused and speed. The contextmenu and mousemove handlers ignore points on the bar. When the round is over, a click still restarts before any HUD hit-test runs.
